name: Terrarium
description: A living, slightly psychedelic world that grows from your workspace: busy agents warm it up, deliveries make it teem with life, failures and debates make it weird. Running tasks drift through it as glowing spirits. Or dream your own worlds from five sliders, and let agents dream some too.
author: Remco Eijsackers

settings.label: Extra trippiness
settings.help: Added to the weirdness your workspace earns by itself. 0 is natural, 1 melts everything.

settings.label: Pulse window (days)
settings.help: How many days of activity shape the world.

options.label: Dream mode (a new world every few minutes)

tools.name: dream_world
tools.description: Dream up a new world for the Terrarium page and keep it in this workspace's gallery. Every number is 0..1 and optional (left out = surprise). Returns the world's field guide: its name, flora and species with their food web.

name.description: A name for the world (optional; otherwise it names itself)

seed.description: Any word or phrase; the same seed grows the same world

lore.description: One or two sentences of lore, shown with the world

tools.name: describe_terrarium
tools.description: Describe this workspace's Terrarium right now: what the recent activity did to the climate, which species live there, who eats whom, and how many tasks drift through it as spirits.
